segments.name: OEM of Heat Transfer Solutions and Aviation Accessories
products: environmental control and power electronics cooling systems
segments.description: Designs, develops and manufactures heat transfer solutions and aviation accessories for commercial, military and business aircraft, mainly through the Kiryat Gat facility.
segments.evidence: Original equipment manufacturing ("OEM") of heat transfer solutions and aviation accessories mainly through our Kiryat Gat facility

segments.name: MRO Services for heat transfer components and OEM of heat transfer solutions
segments.description: Provides heat transfer component MRO and manufactures certain heat transfer solutions through Limco for airlines, cargo carriers, service centers and military.
segments.evidence: MRO services for heat transfer components and OEM of heat transfer solutions through Limco

segments.name: MRO services for Aviation Components and Lease
segments.description: Provides MRO of APUs, landing gear and other aircraft components plus APU lease activity through Piedmont for airlines, carriers and military.
segments.evidence: MRO services for aviation components (mainly APU and LG) through Piedmont

segments.name: Overhaul and coating of jet engine components
segments.description: Overhauls and coats jet engine components, including turbine vanes and blades, through the Turbochrome subsidiary.
segments.evidence: Overhaul and coating of jet engine components through Turbochrome

revenueModel.text: Customers including airlines, air cargo carriers, maintenance service centers, the military and aircraft OEMs pay TAT for manufactured components and MRO services.
